job.title: Software Development Engineer II, Security Products
job.pay_full: $143,700 – $194,400 a year base salary (Seattle and Austin), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: Amazon Security Detection, Response & Engineering (SDRE) is building a new defensive security platform from the ground up, covering threat detection, incident response and digital forensics across endpoint, cloud, network and application vectors for all of Amazon and its subsidiaries. It is a greenfield, AI-first product rather than a legacy system, and this engineer will be a technical leader on a team of software and security engineers, shaping systems that process millions of signals a day.
duties: Own the technical architecture of critical parts of the new platform, built for scale, low latency and resilience
Find ways to apply machine learning, generative AI and automation to detection, response and forensics work
Make build-vs-buy and architecture trade-offs across distributed systems and prototype new technologies
Help shape the product roadmap with product and security leadership
Set team standards for operational excellence, security, testing, CI/CD and observability
Own delivery end to end: design, build, test, deploy and operate production systems
needs: 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
2+ years of non-internship design or architecture of new and existing systems (design patterns, reliability, scaling)
Programming experience in at least one software programming language
nice: 3+ years across the full software development life cycle: coding standards, code reviews, source control, build processes, testing and operations
Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
details.benefits: Base salary $143,700 – $194,400 a year in Austin, TX and Seattle, WA. The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, basic life and AD&D insurance with optional supplemental life, an employee assistance program, mental health support, a medical advice line, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Open in Austin, TX and Seattle, WA
Amazon Security encourages candidates to apply even if they don't meet every qualification
Workplace accommodations are available during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
